**Describe the bug**
A description of what happened that you believe to be bugged behavior.

**To Reproduce**
Describe your configuration of the mod and how you set up the mod generally speaking.

**Expected behavior**
What you expected to happen given your setup

**Screenshots/Videos**
If applicable, add screenshots to help explain your problem.

**Other Mods**
The list of other mods that may have affected the behavior of Resewn Pockets

**Logs**
If you have access to the logs of the session that led up to the bug, please share them.
